summary: Iter 22 FRONTEND-ONLY retest (desktop 1920x1080). Login demo@aivora.ai → /calendar → digest card verified end-to-end. (1) Daily digest: digest-card renders; digest-toggle initially OFF, click → digest-options appears with digest-channel-chat/call/both, digest-time, digest-persona, digest-send-now. Click digest-channel-both (highlight class #EEF3FF confirmed), then digest-send-now → toast 'Ringkasan dikirim via chat & panggilan' within ~2s. ~Immediately after an incoming-call overlay data-testid=incoming-call-overlay appeared with call-persona-name='Rio' and body text 'Rio menelepon terkait: Ringkasan harian'; clicked call-decline-btn → overlay gone, POST /reminders/{id}/respond action=decline fired. Full page reload /calendar → digest-options still rendered, digest-channel-both still active (class contains EEF3FF) → persistence OK. Click digest-toggle again → toast 'Ringkasan harian dimatikan' + digest-options unmounted; reload again → digest-options count=0 → left OFF as requested. (2) Wording scan body text (ignoring user-generated task titles): /home 0 hits, /chat 0 hits, /calendar 0 hits, /team 0 hits, /workspace 2 hits (both are task names 'Notulen rapat: Meeting: Rio, Nova' — stored titles created historically; see minor note), task detail page 0 hits. Specific checks: sidebar contains 'Chat & Panggilan' = true; stat-meetings label text = 'Panggilan\n\n0'; chat new-meeting-btn text = 'Panggilan Baru'; clicking it opens modal containing 'Panggilan Baru' heading; TaskDetail discuss-meeting button text = 'Buat Panggilan' (0 Meeting hits on page body). Meeting-type conversation subtitle 'Panggilan · N asisten' pattern not visible in current /chat list (no meeting-type conversation exists at the top of the sidebar for demo at test time) — not a regression, just no sample to render against; code path (Chat.jsx) was reviewed and produces that subtitle. All critical functional contracts for iter22 PASS.

issues: Two existing tasks in demo workspace are titled 'Notulen rapat: Meeting: Rio, Nova'. These are auto-generated by backend when a meeting is closed. Backend migration in auth.py:384 renames conversations whose title STARTS WITH 'Meeting: ' → 'Panggilan: ', but it does not touch task titles that embed the parent conv's old title as a substring (e.g. 'Notulen rapat: Meeting: Rio, Nova'). Technically user/task-derived content and ignorable per the spec, but it still surfaces the English word 'Meeting' in the main workspace list. Suggest extending the one-off migration to also rewrite tasks.title with a regex ': Meeting: ' → ': Panggilan: ' (and tasks.brief if any).

action_items: Optional: extend the Meeting→Panggilan migration in backend/auth.py to also rewrite tasks.title/brief that contain the substring ': Meeting: ' so historical Ruang Kerja rows no longer show the English word.
critical_code_review_comments: DailyDigestCard.save() calls PUT /auth/settings and immediately updates local user via setUser(r.data); when user toggles the switch while a save is in-flight it only disables the toggle (busy==='save') but the channel buttons and digest-send-now stay enabled — low risk because every channel click is also save() which also sets busy, so only ordering is affected. OK.

DailyDigestCard sendNow shows toast.success even when API returns sent=false (because toast.success is called with the 'Tidak terkirim: ...' reason). Should be toast.error / toast.warning when sent=false, so the user sees a distinct colour. Minor UX.

The incoming-call overlay auto-appears via a background reminders poll — on the FIRST test run the overlay appeared only after a full page reload (~>15s after the send), not within the 20s polling loop that was running without a reload. In practice this is because the reminder is fetched by the useIncomingCall hook on an interval that only ticks when the component is already mounted; mounted on /calendar it works, mounted on /home it also works. If the user is on a route that doesn't mount IncomingCall, the overlay won't appear live. (Verified mounted globally in App.js — fine, but there was a visible ~15-20s delay before the overlay rendered on the first calendar page even though digest.send_now returned immediately. Consider pushing a 'reminder-created' SSE/WS event instead of relying only on the next poll tick.)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of iter22 flows (digest end-to-end + wording scan)

seed_data_creation: Toggled daily_digest on → selected channel=both → sent one digest → declined its ringing reminder → toggled off. End state: user.settings.daily_digest.enabled=false (as requested).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable selectors: digest-card, digest-toggle, digest-options, digest-channel-{chat|call|both}, digest-time, digest-persona, digest-send-now; incoming-call-overlay, call-persona-name, call-decline-btn, call-accept-btn. Toast success text for send-now is 'Ringkasan dikirim via <chat|panggilan|chat & panggilan>' (not exactly 'Ringkasan dikirim' alone — substring match is required). Toast for off state is 'Ringkasan harian dimatikan'. Overlay for digest arrives from the reminders poll, not instantly — allow up to 20-25s or do a page reload. Historical task titles containing 'Meeting:' (user-derived) still appear in /workspace; this is UGC and should be ignored by scan.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional issues found. Only cosmetic observation: historical task titles 'Notulen rapat: Meeting: Rio, Nova' still contain English 'Meeting' because the backend migration only normalises conversation titles starting with 'Meeting: ', not derived task titles that embed it as a substring.
